title: Meghan says U.K. police advised her of 'disturbing allegations' against her father in 2018

blocks.text: World

Prince Harry's wife, Meghan, said Friday she was "deeply distressed" by allegations that a collection of child sexual abuse images had been found at her father's former home. She also revealed that a letter containing "troubling allegations" about him had been sent to London police in 2018.
Statement comes after new report child porn images were found at father's house

Meghan, also known as the Duchess of Sussex, issued the statement after the Sun, a British tabloid newspaper, reported that her half-brother found the images while clearing out the home of their father, Thomas Markle Sr., in the Philippines.
"I am deeply distressed at the news that has come to light in the last 24 hours, and my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed," Meghan said in a statement.
She also addressed the letter sent to the Metropolitan Police Service's Royal and Specialist Protection unit, which later shared its contents with her.

"It made troubling and disturbing allegations against my father and I was given assurances that these were being investigated. I hope it can now be understood that, despite certain media publications' distortion over the years, any distance from my father and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children was for one reason: to protect them."
Brother reported father to police

Thomas Markle Sr., a retired television lighting and photography director, did not attend the wedding, prompting extensive coverage in the British media of Meghan's estrangement from her father. While some reports suggested she had shunned him in favour of her new royal status, Meghan said her decision to distance herself was intended to protect her children.

"Although the breadth of what has now been uncovered is more sickening than one could ever imagine, my sincerest hope is that justice will be fully served and that the priority remains the safety and protection of innocent children," she said in her statement.
Earl Spencer says ‘vicious’ treatment of Harry and Meghan not OK
Thomas Markle Sr. was living in the Philippines earlier this year when he suffered a stroke and had his left leg amputated. That forced him to return to the U.S.

The Sun reported that Thomas Markle Jr. recently found "hundreds, if not thousands" of child sex abuse images in boxes at his father's former home in the Philippine city of Cebu when he was clearing out the property.
Markle Jr. told the newspaper that he reported the images to police in the Philippines and contacted the FBI in the U.S. earlier this year.
"I have supported, cared for him and helped him for years — but that stops now," Markle Jr. told the Sun. "I won't speak to my father ever again unless I'm called to give evidence against him."

blocks.text: Meghan, an actress who starred in the television drama Suits, married Harry at Windsor Castle in 2018. They have two children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet.

Relations with the rest of the Royal Family quickly deteriorated as the couple said palace staff had been insensitive to Meghan’s mental health and levelled charges of racism and media manipulation at other members of the family.
Londoners react to Prince Harry and Meghan’s move back to U.K.

After some time spent in British Columbia, the couple eventually settled in California. After six years there, they returned to the U.K. in September, and made their first joint appearance earlier this month in a series of charity events.
King Charles, Harry’s father, has made clear that the couple remain non-working members of the Royal Family, a status they accepted when they abandoned royal duties and moved to California.
